bio.text: Robert Aderholt represents Alabama's Fourth District in the U.S. House of Representatives and chairs the Appropriations Subcommittee on Labor, Health and Human Services, and Education.
Before Congress he was Assistant Legal Advisor to Governor Fob James and Municipal Judge for Haleyville, Alabama.
He earned a B.A. from Birmingham-Southern College and a J.D. from Cumberland School of Law at Samford University.
Born July 22, 1965, he lives in Haleyville with his wife, Caroline.
